title: Atractive Collection
category: Packaging Design • Label Design • Social Media Design
description: Atractive Collection packaging and campaign design, shown through the supplied body-splash labels, mini-format variants and product-led social artwork. Pattern, colour and fragrance names distinguish the range while the central label structure stays consistent.
challenge: Keep a large fragrance collection connected while making each variant easy to distinguish.
solution: A repeated brand panel and information layout hold the label family together. Fragrance-specific patterns and colour treatments provide variety, while campaign artwork extends the product designs into social content.
results: A selected set of supplied full-size labels, mini labels and campaign artwork. No sales results, brand launch or manufacturing outcome is claimed.
